title: 1963 AHSME Problem 38
statement: Point \(F\) is taken on the extension of side \(AD\) of parallelogram \(ABCD.\) \(BF\) intersects diagonal \(AC\) at \(E\) and side \(DC\) at \(G.\) If \(EF=32\) and \(GF=24,\) then \(BE\) equals:

solutions.text:
Use affine coordinates \(A=0,\) \(B=u,\) \(D=v,\) \(C=u+v,\) and \(F=tv.\) A point on \(FB\) is \(su+t(1-s)v.\) Intersecting \(DC\) gives \(s_G=\frac{t-1}{t},\) while intersecting \(AC\) gives \(s_E=\frac{t}{t+1}.\) Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} \frac{GF}{EF} &=\frac{s_G}{s_E} =\frac{t^2-1}{t^2}\\ &=\frac{24}{32}=\frac34, \end{aligned} \] so \(t=2\) and \(s_E=\frac{2}{3}.\) Thus \(EF=(\frac{2}{3})FB=32,\) making \(FB=48\) and \(BE=16.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Parameterize points on \(FB\) by their fraction of the distance from \(F\) to \(B\)
If \(F=tD\) in affine coordinates based at \(A,\) the parameters of \(G\) and \(E\) are \(\frac{t-1}{t}\) and \(\frac{t}{t+1}\)
